title: Family Courts Act, 1964 (Act No. XXXV of 1964)
description: An Act to make provision for the establishment of Family Courts for the expeditious settlement and disposal of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs and for matters connected therewith.

sections.heading: Jurisdiction of Family Courts
sections.text: Subject to the provisions of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961, and the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961, the Family Courts shall have exclusive jurisdiction to entertain, hear and adjudicate upon matters specified in Part I of the Schedule (including Dissolution of Marriage / Khula, Dower, Maintenance, Restitution of Conjugal Rights, Custody of Children and Guardianship, Jactitation of Marriage, and Dowry).

sections.heading: Pre-trial proceeding and reconciliation
sections.text: When the written statement is filed, the Court shall fix an early date for a pre-trial hearing. At the pre-trial hearing, the Court shall examine the plaint, the written statement and documents, and shall endeavour to effect a compromise or reconciliation between the parties.
